app.name: Amazon India Shop, Pay, miniTV
app.description: India's leading shopping app for products, payments, and streaming, offering a vast marketplace with fast delivery and integrated entertainment.

verdict.one_liner: Amazon collects extensive data including your contacts, device files, and browsing habits to power its shopping and advertising services, but promises not to sell your personal information.
verdict.summary: Amazon India's privacy policy reveals broad data collection across categories. It accesses device file metadata, uploads contacts for certain features, tracks your full browsing behavior, and uses advertising identifiers for interest-based ads. On the positive side, Amazon explicitly commits to not selling personal information, uses encryption and PCI DSS standards, and promises not to materially weaken privacy protections for past data without consent. The policy is transparent but data hungry.
verdict.recommendation_reason: If you are concerned about behavioral tracking, contact uploads, and broad device fingerprinting for ads, consider whether the convenience of Amazon's ecosystem is worth the data trade-off.

red.title: Your behavior powers interest-based ads
red.plain_english: Amazon tracks your shopping history, browsing habits, and app usage to show you targeted ads. It also shares an advertising identifier with ad companies to measure ad performance.

red.title: App can access file metadata on your phone
red.plain_english: Amazon's apps may access metadata and other information associated with files stored on your mobile device, including photographs, audio, and video clips.

red.title: Contacts can be uploaded for certain features
red.plain_english: Amazon allows you to upload your mobile device contacts for certain services. This includes phone numbers of people who may not have agreed to share their information.

red.title: Device identifiers used for advertising
red.plain_english: Amazon collects device identifiers, advertising IDs, and cookie data to recognize you and deliver targeted ads across its services.

red.title: Full browsing clickstream is logged
red.plain_english: Amazon collects the full URL clickstream of the websites you visit, along with page interaction details like scrolling, clicks, and mouse-overs.

green.title: Explicit no-sale commitment
green.plain_english: Amazon explicitly states that it is not in the business of selling customers' personal information to others.

green.title: Encryption and PCI DSS compliance
green.plain_english: Amazon uses encryption protocols to protect your information during transmission and follows Payment Card Industry security standards for card data.

green.title: Material policy changes need consent
green.plain_english: Amazon promises it will never materially change its policies to make them less protective of customer information collected in the past without the consent of affected customers.

green.title: Advertising preferences can be adjusted
green.plain_english: You can adjust your advertising preferences and opt out of some interest-based ads through Amazon's Advertising Preferences page.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: Amazon only uses your camera and microphone when you actively choose to use features like image search, voice search, or Alexa voice services.
categories.detail: The policy mentions voice, image, and camera services. Voice input and images are collected when you actively use these features. There is no indication of background camera or microphone access.
categories.policy_excerpt: When you use our voice, image and camera services, we use your voice input, images, videos, and other personal information to respond to your requests.
concerns: Voice recordings may be stored and used to improve services

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: Amazon collects your device location when you use location-related features like delivery tracking, and also estimates your general location from your IP address.
categories.detail: Location information is collected automatically and when you provide it. It is used for delivery, recommendations, and fraud prevention. IP-based location inference is continuous.
categories.policy_excerpt: We automatically collect and store certain types of information about your use of Amazon Services, including information about your interaction with content and services... the location of your device or computer.

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: Amazon allows you to upload your contacts for certain services. This means phone numbers and names from your address book are sent to Amazon's servers.
categories.detail: The policy explicitly mentions uploading contacts and accessing mobile device contacts for certain services. This data is stored on Amazon servers.
categories.policy_excerpt: upload your contacts, including access to mobile device contacts for certain services
concerns: Non-users' contact information uploaded without their consent

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: Amazon's apps may access metadata and other information associated with files stored on your mobile device, including photos, audio, and video clips.
categories.detail: The policy states that applications may access metadata and other information associated with files on your device. This is broad library access beyond user-initiated uploads.
categories.policy_excerpt: Our applications may also access metadata and other information associated with files stored on your mobile device. This may include, for example, photographs, audio and video clips.
concerns: Broad file metadata access beyond user-initiated uploads

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: Amazon shares your data with sellers, merchants, advertisers, service providers, and other companies for fraud protection, delivery, and credit risk reduction.
categories.detail: Amazon explicitly states it does not sell personal information, but shares it with a wide array of third parties including third-party advertisers, sellers on the marketplace, restaurants, merchants, and service providers. Data is also exchanged with other companies for fraud protection and credit risk reduction.
categories.policy_excerpt: We share customers' personal information related to those transactions with that third party... We employ other companies and individuals to perform functions on our behalf.
concerns: Data shared with third-party advertisers and ad companies
Data exchanged with other companies for fraud protection

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: You must provide your name, address, phone number, and email to use Amazon. For some services, government IDs like PAN numbers may be collected.
categories.detail: Account creation requires extensive identity data. The policy mentions collection of officially valid documents including PAN numbers for identity verification. However, Amazon states it does not use identifiable personal information for interest-based ads.
categories.policy_excerpt: identifying information such as your name, address and phone numbers... information and officially valid documents regarding identity and address information, including PAN numbers

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: Amazon uses your shopping history, searches, browsing behavior, and device identifiers to show you interest-based ads both on and off Amazon.
categories.detail: The policy describes extensive use of personal information for advertising, including interest-based ads. It uses advertising identifiers and shares them with ad companies. While Amazon says it does not use information that personally identifies you for interest-based ads, it uses cookies, device identifiers, and behavioral data for ad targeting.
categories.policy_excerpt: We use your personal information to display interest-based ads for features, products, and services that might be of interest to you.
concerns: Behavioral tracking for ad targeting across services
Advertising identifiers shared with ad companies

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: Amazon says its services are not for children under 18 without a parent or guardian. Products for children are sold to adults only.
categories.detail: The policy states that users under 18 may use Amazon Services only with the involvement of a parent or guardian. There is no technical age verification mechanism described.
categories.policy_excerpt: If you are under the age of 18 years, you may use Amazon Services only with the involvement of a parent or guardian.

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: Amazon logs your IP address, full URL clickstream, and detailed page interactions including scrolling, clicks, and how long you stay on pages.
categories.detail: The policy explicitly collects the full URL clickstream, page interaction data, IP address, and browsing details. This is used for recommendations, ads, and diagnostics. The scope of logging is extensive and goes beyond standard security logging.
categories.policy_excerpt: the full Uniform Resource Locator (URL) clickstream to, through, and from our websites, including date and time; products and content you viewed or searched for; page response times, download errors, length of visits to certain pages, and page interaction information

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: Amazon collects device identifiers, advertising IDs, cookies, device configurations, and Wi-Fi credentials to recognize your device and deliver ads.
categories.detail: The policy mentions collection of device log files, configurations, unique identifiers, cookies, and advertising identifiers. These are used for recognition, advertising, and service improvement.
categories.policy_excerpt: device log files and configurations, including Wi-Fi credentials... We use cookies and other identifiers... we use an advertising identifier like a cookie, a device identifier
concerns: Advertising identifiers collected and used for tracking
Device configurations and Wi-Fi credentials collected

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: Amazon does not collect health or biometric data through this app.
categories.detail: The provided privacy policy text does not mention collection of health or biometric data for the Amazon India shopping app.

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: Amazon collects and processes your payment card information following industry security standards when you make purchases.
categories.detail: Payment information is collected and handled in accordance with PCI DSS. The app processes payment card data directly for transactions.
categories.policy_excerpt: We follow the Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) when handling payment card data.
concerns: Payment data retained for transactions and fraud prevention

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: You can access and update some of your information in Your Account. For other data, you can submit a request, but the policy does not clearly detail deletion rights in the provided text.
categories.detail: The policy mentions accessing information through Your Account and submitting requests for information not available there. It does not explicitly describe account deletion or data erasure procedures in the provided text, though some choices like opting out of communications are described.
categories.policy_excerpt: You can access your information... in the 'Your Account' section... To request access to personal information that is not available through Your Account you can submit a request here.
concerns: Deletion rights not clearly described in provided text

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: Amazon promises it will never make material changes that make the policy less protective of your past data without getting your consent first.
categories.detail: The policy states that continued use applies to the current notice, but explicitly promises that material changes making policies less protective will not apply to information collected in the past without customer consent.
categories.policy_excerpt: We stand behind the promises we make, however, and will never materially change our policies and practices to make them less protective of customer information collected in the past without the consent of affected customers.
